_notes: Optional. Copy to config/indexers.json to have configure-lidarr.py register indexers in Lidarr automatically.
Each entry is passed verbatim to POST /api/v1/indexer. The schema follows the Servarr API: name/implementation/configContract/fields.
Private trackers: add username/password fields per that tracker's Cardigann definition.
Reality check: public trackers exist but are weak for music. A private music tracker or usenet indexer gives far better results.
